keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks the Imamate). The page gives no extent; Harar (the former capital) stays in the Imamate until "In 1647, the rulers of the Emirate of Harar broke away to form their own polity". The Adal dossier (af-01-a/b) has Harar independent after 1577; the two disagree.
New keyframe: the Imamate after Harar broke away; the Afar lowlands around Aussa. No area on the page.

sources.title: Sultanate of Aussa
sources.note: Imamate of Aussa 1577-1672, Harar breaks away 1647, Mudaito sultanate from 1734, Munzinger 1875, Italian protectorate 6 Dec 1889, Arraddo Jan 1896, Italian occupation 1 April 1936. Infobox area 76,868 km2.

notes: New dossier from one page: Sultanate of Aussa (also covers the Imamate). The Imamate's extent is the page's silence: only Aussa, Harar and the Afar are named. Disagreement: the Adal Sultanate dossier says Harar became independent in 1577, this page keeps it in the Imamate until 1647. The Imamate of Aussa has no page of its own in this run (the title redirects to the Sultanate). Coordinates of Aussa are approximate. Gazetteer names needed: Aussa (Awsa, Asaita), about 11.57 N 41.43 E.
